channel.title: Vox Updates
channel.description: Updates for Vox — push-to-talk dictation for macOS.

item.title: Vox 0.5.0
item.description:
• Main window: sidebar nav (Home / Dictionary / Meeting / Settings / Help). Auto-opens on launch, hides on close. Click menu-bar icon to reopen.
  • Home: stat cards plus recent dictations and recent meetings.
  • Dictation history: every dictation is saved to disk. Configurable retention (forever / 1y / 90d / 30d) in Settings.
  • Fix: Whisper hallucination filter drops the "yeah, yeah, yeah, ..." 30-second repetitions on quiet mic input.
  • Fix: Keychain access cached in process memory so dictations no longer re-prompt for ACL approval each time.
  • Fix: meeting Delete now correctly redraws (was a UI-refresh bug, not data loss).

item.title: Vox 0.4.0
item.description:
• Meeting transcription M2: captures local mic in parallel with system audio. Segments tagged local/remote, interleaved on a shared timeline.
  • Silence trim: leading/trailing silence is clipped before transcription so starting a recording before anyone joins doesn't pollute the transcript.
  • Fix: Whisper pinned to language=en, temperature=0 — no more random Japanese hallucinations on silent audio.
  • Visual: distinct red+pulsing menu bar icon during meeting recording. Audible cue when Fn-dictation is suppressed because a meeting is active.
  • Fix: hotkey recorder accepts multi-modifier combos (Ctrl+Opt+M, etc); existing global hotkey is muted while configuring a new one.
  • Fix: stale meeting session bug — could not start a new session after completing/failing one.

item.title: Vox 0.3.2
item.description:
• Fix: Transcription no longer hangs indefinitely when OpenAI stalls. Added a 20s request timeout so failures surface and the menu icon resets.
  • Feature: Spoken "slash" now becomes "/" in command mode. "slash help" → "/help" for Claude Code / Slack / Discord slash commands. "cd slash usr slash local" → "cd /usr/local".

item.title: Vox 0.3.1
item.description: • Fix: Smart Cleanup no longer responds with "Sure, please provide the text…" on short dictations. gpt-4o-mini was treating brief snippets as chat requests; tightened the system prompt and added a short-input bypass (under 15 chars skips the LLM entirely).

item.title: Vox 0.3.0
item.description:
• Smart Cleanup (prose mode) — opt-in LLM polish via gpt-4o-mini removes false starts, fillers, and self-corrections. Settings → Mode → Smart cleanup. Trigger phrases also work: "scratch that" / "delete that" wipes the preceding clause; "new paragraph" inserts \n\n; "new line" inserts \n.
  • Tri-state mode override — Settings → Mode → Auto / Always prose / Always command. Mode-toggle hotkey cycles all three. Lets you force command mode in non-terminal apps (e.g. dictating shell commands into a journal).
  • Arrow + modifier suffix keys — say "control left", "option right", "command shift right" at end of dictation. Works for in-app shortcuts. (Mission Control space-switching needs physical keys — synthetic events filtered by macOS.)
  • Hallucination guard — gpt-4o-mini-transcribe sometimes loops on short or noisy audio (a 3-second clip can produce thousands of repeated chars). Vox now suppresses runaway STT output instead of pasting it.
  • Fix: "cd dot dot" now produces "cd .." (was "cd ." — one dot lost). Same fix preserves "./scripts/build-app.sh" without the stray space.
  • Fix: dictionary entries match repeated occurrences of a word in one sentence, including when punctuation is attached ("Andie, … Andie." now both replace).
  • Fix: "control C" produces real Ctrl+C even when Whisper encodes the spoken phrase as the literal "^C" symbol.

Reminder: macOS TCC keys permission grants on the bundle's cdhash, which changes on every ad-hoc-signed release. After updating, re-grant Microphone, Input Monitoring, and Accessibility in System Settings → Privacy & Security.

item.title: Vox 0.2.1
item.description:
• In-app updates via Sparkle (Check for Updates… in the menu).
  • macOS 26 hotkey recorder + monitor stability fixes.
  • Single-modifier hotkey support (bare ⌘ / ⌃ / ⌥ / ⇧).
  • Menu-bar icon redesign with mode-aware colors.
